Problem Statement:
Write a program that demonstrates the use of static methods by creating a utility class with a method to find the maximum of two numbers. 
Input Description:
Two integers separated by a space. 
Output Description:
The maximum of the two integers. 
Sample Input:
5 10 
Sample Output:
10
